newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Bank Ekspres secures $30 mln syndication.
newsitem.headline: Turk Bank Ekspres secures $30 mln syndication.

text.p: Turkish Bank Ekspres, a small private bank, said on Wednesday it secured a $30 million, one-year syndication loan from international markets for use in export finance.
Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank was the arranger and Banque Francaise Du Commerce Exterieur was the lead manager in the facility, Bank Ekspres said in a statement.

It said a total of 19 banks, including managers American Express Bank GmbH, Arab Banking Corporation, Barclays Bank Plc, Corestates Bank NA and National Westminster Bank Plc participated in the syndication.
Bank Ekspres mandated for a $25 million loan, but the deal was increased to $30 million because of oversubscription.
This was the second syndication loan secured by Bank Ekspres this year.
